{Naruto} leaps onto the {Roof} of the {Hut} and lands beside a *nun* whose *mouth* tacks a **question particle** onto every sentence: ramen, ne? Headband, ne? He makes a hundred shadow clones to answer her, but each orange clone catches the habit and adds the same **question particle** at the top of his voice. Soon the whole hillside is shouting, ne? ne? ne?

{Cookie Monster} barrels {Inside} the {Casino} with a *piggy bank* as big as a pony, and the manager tells him to **deposit** his cookies for safekeeping. {Walter White} adjusts his glasses in the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} and drips a precise growth formula onto a *sapling*, asking if it is a mighty oak, and **not yet**, it squeaks. He checks his calculations, adds a drop, knocks on the bark like the one who knocks and asks again, and it squeaks **not yet**. {Yoshi} slurps up a *yuan coin* in the {Basement} of the {Mint}, lays it as a speckled egg and hurls it along a *road* painted on the floor. {James Bond} picks up Q's newest telephone in the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}: a giant *mouth* on the end of a *twisted vine*, built to do one thing. It **calls**. 'Bond, James Bond,' it booms, then it **calls** every cat in town, and hundreds pour through the windows and settle on his tuxedo. 'Wrong number,' he says, unruffled.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Island} on a long vine with a jungle yell and lands on a *stage* left behind by tourists. He calls his ape family over, and they all climb up and beat their chests on the **platform** until the seagulls applaud.

{Darth Vader} Force-lifts one huge *racket* in {Front} of the {Mansion} and plays tennis with a **single** ball, his loud breathing marking every stroke. No partner, no net, no opponent. The butler brings out a second racket, and Vader Force-chokes it into a crumpled twist, booming his disapproval: this match has one **single** player, and it always will.

{Yoshi} licks a paintbrush's wet *bristles* in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} and swallows a painted *landscape* for afters. He lays a glowing egg that cracks and throws a bright moving **image** on the wall: hills, a river, a sunset. A painted cow steps out of the **image** to drink from the water bucket, and the boxers forget to fight.

{James Bond} opens a *toolbox* from Q in the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, and every **tool** does one absurd thing: the spanner whistles, the saw sings opera, the hammer only hits on Tuesdays. An alarm wails and the guards close in. Unruffled, he checks his watch, sees it is Tuesday, and escapes through the wall with the one **tool** that works.

{Lara Croft} swings {Inside} the {Warehouse} on a rope with a *gauze net*, **collecting** ancient relics from the top shelves: a cursed button, a lost sock of the pharaohs, a jade kite. A rolling boulder chases her down the aisle. She somersaults over it, nets it too, and **collects** one last prize, the warehouse manager, who was only passing.

{Zorro} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive}, slashing a Z into everything, until a *child* under a tiny *roof* tuts and shows him how to write a proper Chinese **character**. Zorro tries again, and his rapier whirls with stroke after stroke as the bees fly into line. They spell one huge **character** in the air, and he vanishes laughing behind it.

{Casper} floats through the wall of the {Bathroom} on the {Island}, and every castaway runs away screaming, though he only said hello. Then he finds a coconut with a painted smile that does not flee, his first *friend*. He falls in **love** at once, drifting around it in the moonlight, and turns invisible when he blushes. It says nothing, and he is sure that it is **love**.

{James Bond} flicks open a briefcase from Q in {Front} of the {Beach} huts, and a spring-loaded *punch* in a boxing glove shoots out. Bam! It **strikes** a coconut, a sandcastle and a henchman's hat, and then it turns round looking for more. Bond steps aside without creasing his tuxedo as it **strikes** his ice cream into orbit, and he calls the result quite **striking**.

{Lara Croft} pulls a forbidden lever {Inside} the {Youth Hostel}, and *water drops* start to trickle from the stone walls, then gush. It is an ancient flood trap. A *tumbling baby* in a rubber ring **flows** past, giggling, so Lara runs along the wall, ponytail flying, and scoops it up as the torrent **flows** through the bunks and out to sea.

{Batman} broods in the {Bathroom} of the {Lake}, because Batman must always **prepare** for the worst. His *trudging feet* carry him out to a frozen *rice field* with a fully stocked belt: bat-sickle, bat-umbrella, weevil repellent. No villain comes, not one, but he has **prepared** so thoroughly that when a lone squirrel appears, he has the exact gadget.

{Batman} glides down in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring}, where *troops* of tin **soldiers** are marching left, right, left. He flings a batarang, which clips the first in line and topples the whole row like dominoes. Standing over them he growls for their commander, and the last brave **soldier** gets up, salutes and asks to be his sidekick.

{Lara Croft} climbs a stone ledge {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} and finds an ancient puzzle: a *convoy* of tiny carts that must **link** in exactly the right order. She flips between them, ponytail swinging, hooking each one to the next. As the last cart clicks, all of them **link** into one long chain, the vault groans open, and out rolls a boulder.

{Darth Vader} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, where a giant *circuit* hums and a *small speech bubble* rides its wires reading out his disapproval: you are being **transferred**! With a lift of his glove, the Force picks up a sleeping cat and **transfers** it to command of a Star Destroyer. Vader breathes loudly, and the fleet is told to purr.

{Sherlock} drops a coin down a hole in {Front} of the {Funfair} and listens to *water drops* echoing from a *deep cave* far below. Counting on his violin bow, he smugly deduces that it must be exactly one thousand metres **deep**. Elementary. Watson leans over to check and falls in, and it is so **deep** that his reply arrives a week later.

{Sherlock} marches up in {Front} of the {Hangar}, magnifies a single crumb and deduces that a **merchant** is at work. Sure enough, a *skylight* flips open overhead and a voice sells him a second magnifying glass, a violin string and a slightly used cloud. Watson points out that the **merchant** has also sold him back his own crumb.

{Sailor Moon} starts her transformation in the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond}, and her moon wand turns a stick of *bamboo* into a glittering *abacus*. In the name of the moon she will **calculate** how many breadcrumbs each swan deserves! She clacks the beads, gets forty-seven and a half, and cries loudly, so Luna sighs and **calculates** it all again with one paw.

The {Joker} sneaks into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} dressed as an inspector, tapping each golden *shell* with a *pair of axes* made of rubber. Honk! Top **quality**, he cackles, and stamps it with a huge grin. The queen presents her own shell and he declares it poor **quality**, at which point it squirts him in the face, and the bees cheer.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Swan Pond} and gives a jungle yell, baffled by a tiny *fence* around one *green shoot*. He calls to the animals, and swans, ducks and frogs all rush up in one big honking **group**. The fence gives way, the shoot springs up into a great tree, and the whole **group** climbs it behind him.

{James Bond} blows Q's newest whistle {Inside} the {Beach}, a gadget that does one thing: every *sparrow* for miles comes to **gather** in the same *tree*. Hundreds arrive, then thousands, and the tree bends like a fishing rod. They **gather** on his shoulders and his bow tie too, and Bond, unruffled, says he seems to draw a crowd.

{Batman} fires his grappling hook in the {Basement} of the {Island} and snags a *banknote* poking through the floorboards. He hauls, and out comes another and another: a **hundred** of them, tied in a line. Being a detective, he finds that each bears a tiny bat, so he folds them, brooding, and flings all **hundred** across the room like batarangs.

{Shrek} stands *waiting in rain* in {Front} of the {Museum}, wanting only to be left alone, while Donkey will not shut up. You **need** an umbrella, says Donkey, you need a hug, you need a friend. Shrek roars, and the marble goddesses flinch. He says all he will ever **need** is his swamp, and then he remembers this rain is making one.

{James Bond} steps out of the {Bathroom} of the {Piazza} to buy an ice cream, and a *go-between* runs off to haggle while a *standing person* shouts each new **price**. 'Bond. James Bond,' he says, and the **price** doubles. He pays with a pen from Q, whose cheque unfolds into a parachute, and he floats off with the cone, unruffled.

{Homer} naps on the *grass* in {Front} of the {Water Park} until it tickles his nose and he spots a *shape-shifter* turning into a giant doughnut. 'Mmm,' he says, and he pounces, and just as he bites, it turns into a pink **flower**. With a 'D'oh!' he chews it anyway, shrugs, and goes back to sleep with the **flower** stuck in his teeth.

{Darth Vader} booms 'I am your father' in the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, but the man wearing a *lampshade* only corrects him: he is his *big brother*, and the leader of a political **party**. The mice cheer. Vader Force-lifts the lampshade in disapproval, the crowd takes it as a campaign promise, and the **party** elects him Minister of Breathing.

{Homer} sneaks {Inside} the {Water Park} at night with a dim scheme to toast one doughnut over a box of *fireworks*. 'D'oh!' The whole crate goes up, gold, crimson and emerald, and he rockets down the slide in a shower of sparks. The sky turns **splendid**, the crowd gasps, and he says 'Mmm, **splendid**' with the toasted doughnut in his mouth.

{Charlie Brown} spends all summer piling *soil* into walls and towers {Inside} the {Jungle}, hoping at last to win the golden *trophy* for best **city**. Monkeys and tapirs move in with briefcases and traffic lights. Good grief: the trophy goes to Snoopy's kennel, and his own **city** will not let him in without a permit.

{Sherlock} picks up a *stone* {Inside} the {Beehive} and studies it through his magnifying glass, deducing at once that this **stone** has been to Peru, is left-handed and has a slight cold. {James Bond} water-skis {Inside} the {Beach} on a *silk thread* from a Q speedboat, with a *chaser* thundering behind him. The {Joker} hires a *drill sergeant* in the {Basement} of the {Jungle} to march the **whole** jungle up to a *goal line*: every ant, every elephant, every vine. {Frodo} wanders into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and finds a tiny marble *mansion*, where frogs in suits are running the **government**. {Lara Croft} lifts a relic {Inside} the {Beach} ruins, and a *goblin* guarding it squeaks that the trap has sprung and they must **leave** now. {Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Swamp}, arms flailing, and finds his *big brother* trapped in a block of *icicles* with the show starting in a minute. {Yoshi} shoots out his tongue in the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} and swallows a *silver medal* the size of a frying pan. 'Yoshi!' {Chewbacca} wants to **invite** the whole town to a party in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, but only friends understand his roars. {James Bond} wakes tied to a *branch* in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} as a line of crabs advances. {James Bond} finds himself in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} wedged **between** a *hillside* and a stone *altar*, which a villain's trap is slowly pushing closer. {Yoshi} ties a *promise knot* in his own long tongue in {Front} of the {Ice Rink} so he will remember an **appointment**. Then, out of habit, he swallows it. 'Yoshi?' He lays an egg, it hatches into a tiny diary, and every page is another missed **appointment**, including one to untie his tongue.

{Sherlock} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive}, climbs up on the bees' *altar* and promises to **show** them who stole the honey. {Frodo} sets off from the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} on bare feet with the longest walk of his life ahead of him, and at the far end he buys a ticket for the *return trip*. {Batman} lies on a *sickbed* balanced on a wobbly *tripod* in the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring}, struck down by a strange **illness**: each sneeze fires a batarang from his belt. {Shrek} lies down in {Front} of the {Beach} lifeguard tower for a long **rest**, away from everyone. {James Bond} prises open the {Front} of the {Youth Hostel} with a *crowbar* from Q and finds a *cave* hidden behind the porch, full of muddy footprints. {Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} wanting to be left alone, so he unrolls a *silk thread* while *twin blades* snip it to length, and lays it down as one dead-straight **line**. {Sailor Moon} spots a *standing person* holding a *tool* in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive}, and it **seems** to be a villain with a weapon. {Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Swan Pond} exactly when he means to, and an *official* in a tall hat stamps a form and declares, 'You shall not pass!' {Homer} lights a tiny *campfire* in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} to toast a doughnut, ignoring everything he learned at the plant. The **fire** gobbles the doughnut and then the box. 'D'oh!' {Darth Vader} Force-lifts an *axe* in the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond}, breathing loudly at a stuck rowing boat, and Force-chokes the oar until it **breaks**. Crack! {James Bond} pours *rice* and *moss* into a silver shaker in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring}, and shakes it, never stirs it, until only one glowing drop remains: pure **essence**. {Mario} the plumber unscrews one pipe in the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, and *water drops* come pouring out without end. The sink is **full**, the room is **full** and the butler is swimming laps. The {Joker} props up a sagging awning with a forked *branch* in {Front} of the {Beehive}, a trick one that should fold up at once and dump the queen in the honey. Cackling, he waits. {Sherlock} tiptoes into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and finds a *watcher* kneeling at a *small altar* with a telescope on it. The watcher **looks at** Sherlock. {Shrek} roars at a *portrait* of Donkey in {Front} of the {Cat Café}, and its painted eyes weep *water drops* that flood the lawn. The cats climb the awning. {Yoshi} licks up a *runner* and his *ceremonial axe* in the {Bathroom} of the {Ice Rink}, and lays an egg that hatches two more of them. **The more** he swallows, the more eggs he lays, and **the more** eggs he lays, the more runners skate out twirling axes. {Chewbacca} rips the hand dryer off the wall in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and, growling happily, rebuilds it into a strange **device** with four horns and a crank. {Robocop} clanks {Inside} the {Lagoon} with an empty *container* and reads out a directive: all disorderly fish must be **contained**. The {Joker} blows on a pile of *embers* in the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} until they glow, then feeds them into a giant *spotlight*. {Shrek} finds a *page* of rules nailed up in {Front} of the {Museum}, which Donkey reads aloud without pausing for breath: all ogres **must** wipe their feet, and all ogres **must** be brushed. {James Bond} levers open a crate with a *crowbar* from Q in the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel}, and it folds out into exactly **nine** gadgets, none of which helps. {Zorro} rides up on his black horse in {Front} of the {Jungle}, pours *soil* into a bamboo *steamer* and slashes a Z through the lid, and with a puff the soil doubles. {Yoshi} does his **research** {Inside} the {Mansion} the only way he knows: he swallows a *stone*, then a heavy *door bar*, then the butler's notebook, and studies whatever comes out. Each time he lays an egg. He taps every shell with his nose and says 'Yoshi!' gravely. After weeks of **research**, his finding is that all things are eggs.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Basement} of the {Yeti Cave} and sits at a *writing desk*, grumpily determined to **write** one sign saying Keep Out. Donkey stands behind him dictating improvements, and the ogre, who has never been so annoyed, keeps on **writing** them down. {Charlie Brown} hangs a *wind chime* made of *grain stalk* in {Front} of the {Jungle} temple, and whenever it tinkles it gives a passing animal a **name**: Bob for a tapir, Gertrude for a tiger. Every creature gets a splendid **name**, and then Charlie steps up hopefully, zigzag shirt straightened, and it tinkles, Blockhead. Good grief.

{Chewbacca} digs down into the {Basement} of the {Beach} and finds a *person* beside a *stop sign*, running a tiny **enterprise** that sells stop signs to crabs. The sign blocks his way, so he roars and rips it in half. The person hands him a bill, and he sulkily rebuilds it with engines, and now the **enterprise** sells flying stop signs.
